title: Ing Pikamalan a Kaladwa a Mengutang king Awtoridad
intro: keng annals ning quran, ating metung a tau na ing kayang pibandian ampo beluan meging legendary ya. Ing kaladwa ayni linwal ya keng yatu a maki alahas ampo pibandian na makapagmulala kareng manalbe, pero ing pusu da meging mayabang ya keng kayabangan. Makiabe ka kekami kabang bubuklat mi ing misteryu ning metung kareng peka-cautionary tales ning Quran, nung nukarin ing materyal a kadakilaan akit ne ing metung a makapakumbaba a wakas lalam ning mismung gabun a mibait king karelang kapalaran.
clues: linwal ku keng yatu a maka-adornu kareng alahas na maka-akit keng panimanman da reng sabla.
Atin kung maragul a pibandian ampo malalam a beluan na makayaliwa kanaku kareng aliwa.
Inyang dinatang ya ing metung a tubud a mamaus kareng tau king Allah, kitnan ke ing karelang awtoridad a maki kayabangan.
Deng atyu king paligid ku bubulong da na ing pabor nang Allah ali ya ing panibatan ning kanakung pibandian.
Mengapamulala la ding memalen ku king kanakung kadakilaan at pignasan da ing kapalaran a kalupa ku.
Ding kanakung mangasanting a istruktura melaso la ngan keng gabun bilang banal a parusa.

arabic: وَقَـٰرُونَ وَفِرْعَوْنَ وَهَـٰمَـٰنَ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مُّوسَىٰ بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ سَـٰبِقِينَ
verse: And [We destroyed] Qārūn and Pharaoh and Hāmān. And Moses had already come to them with clear evidences, and they were arrogant in the land, but they were not outrunners [of Our punishment]. (29:39)
